name: Mario Kart
author: Local vehicle SDK example
description: Rapier kart using your supplied model. F10 spawns nearby, E enters/exits, WASD drives, Space brakes, Shift handbrake, R resets. Slow down before exiting. Fitted entry/exit and steering animations included.

tire_friction.label: Tire friction coefficient
tire_friction.description: Combined braking and cornering grip. 1.3 is the dry kart setup; lower values allow more sliding.

hud.label: Show driving HUD
hud.description: Show keyboard and controller controls, current reset bind, speed and vehicle state.

reset_button.label: Controller reset bind
reset_button.description: Click this stick while driving to reset the kart. R remains the keyboard shortcut.

engine_volume.label: Engine volume
engine_volume.description: Engine loudness; zero mutes the motor.
